source.original_text:
Add a continuous finite-variation drift to a finite row of original completed Itô integrals evaluated at a common bounded stop. The squared dyadic increments of the sum converge in measure to the original integrated square energy up to the stop.

One actual finite-dimensional Euclidean Brownian motion under a finite sample measure μ, relative to a filtration satisfying the usual conditions.
A positive deterministic horizon T, one common finite-valued stopping time with τ(ω)≤T at every sample point, and progressive product-space L² input in each coordinate.
The drift A is almost surely continuous and of bounded variation on [0,T]. Its deterministic-time values are almost everywhere strongly measurable. No moment of the total variation is required.

\begin{gathered}X_t=A_t+\sum_j I^j_{t\wedge\tau}(\eta_j),\\ \sum_i(\Delta_i X)^2\ \longrightarrow\ \sum_j\int_{[0,\tau]}\eta_j(t)^2\,dt\qquad\text{in measure}.\end{gathered}

lean.statement:
theorem anonymous_target.{u_1,
    u_2}
  {Omega : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace Omega] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
  {filtration : MeasureTheory.Filtration NNReal inferInstance} {mu : MeasureTheory.Measure Omega}
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure mu] {T : NNReal} {B : NNReal → Omega → EuclideanSpace ℝ J}
  (hB :
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.BrownianMotion.IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration B
      filtration mu)
  (hT : 0 < T)
  (hUsual : AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration mu)
  (eta :
    J → AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration mu T)
  (tau : Omega → NNReal)
  (htau :
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.StoppingTime.IsChewiStoppingTime filtration fun omega =>
      ↑(tau omega))
  (htauT : ∀ (omega : Omega), tau omega ≤ T) (A : NNReal → Omega → ℝ)
  (hAmeas : ∀ t ≤ T, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (A t) mu)
  (hA :
    ∀ᵐ (omega : Omega) ∂mu,
      ContinuousOn (fun t => A t omega) (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧ BoundedVariationOn (fun t => A t omega) (Set.Icc 0 T)) :
  have hcoord := ⋯;
  have X := fun t omega =>
    A t omega +
      ∑ j,
        AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralProcess.itoIntegralProcess (eta j) hT ⋯ hUsual
          (Min.min (tau omega) t) omega;
  MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure mu
    (fun level omega =>
      have times :=
        AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes
          (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh T level)
          (2 ^ level);
      ∑ i, (X (times i.succ) omega - X (times i.castSucc) omega) ^ 2)
    Filter.atTop fun omega =>
    ∑ j,
      ∫ (t : NNReal) in Set.Iic (tau omega),
        (eta j).process t omega ^ 2 ∂AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T

blind_reconstruction.text:
Let J be finite with decidable equality, Omega a measurable space with finite measure mu, F a filtration satisfying the usual conditions, T>0, and B an R^J-valued standard Brownian motion with F. A vector standard Brownian motion with filtration F here starts at zero for every sample, has jointly independent increments over each finite family of disjoint half-open intervals, has centered Gaussian increment projections with variance (t-s)*||ell||^2 for every continuous linear functional ell and s<t, has almost surely continuous paths, is strongly F-adapted, and has each increment from s to t independent of F_s when s<=t. Usual conditions mean every null subset of Omega belongs to every F_t, and F is right-continuous. Write lambda_H for real Lebesgue measure restricted to [0,H] and transported to NNReal. A progressive L2 integrand on horizon H is a real strongly F-progressive process belonging to L2(mu product lambda_H), after ordering its arguments as (omega,t). Write I^H_j(h)(t) for its specified completed Ito integral against the coordinate B_j(t,omega) of B. This is the canonical elementary-approximation path limit, patched to zero on its exceptional null set and held constant after H. For each j in J let eta_j be a progressive L2 integrand on [0,T]. Let tau:Omega->NNReal be a stopping time for F (through its inclusion in WithTop NNReal), with tau(omega)<=T for every omega. Let A:NNReal x Omega->R have, for every t<=T, an mu-almost-everywhere strongly measurable slice A(t,.), and have paths continuous and of bounded variation on [0,T] for mu-almost every omega. Define
X(t,omega)=A(t,omega)+sum_j I^T_j(eta_j)(min(tau(omega),t),omega).
For n in N set t_i^n=i*T/2^n. Then sum_{i=0}^{2^n-1}(X(t_{i+1}^n,omega)-X(t_i^n,omega))^2 converges in mu-measure, as n tends to infinity, to sum_j integral_{[0,T] intersect [0,tau(omega)]} eta_j(s,omega)^2 ds. Only the Ito-integral part of X is stopped; A is evaluated at the unstopped time t. No adaptedness assumption on A is made.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.FiniteVariationDyadicQV
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoStoppedRowQV

/-! # Adding a continuous finite-variation drift to a stopped Itô row -/

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoFiniteVariationQV

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators
open BrownianMotion ProgressiveL2 StoppingTime ElementaryItoIntegral
  SampledElementaryApproximation DyadicElementaryRefinement EuclideanBrownianCoordinates
  ItoIntegralProcess ItoIntegralProcessAfterHorizon ItoStoppedRowQV
  RandomStoppingProcessConsistency FiniteVariationDyadicQV

/-- A continuous finite-variation drift leaves the stopped Itô row's
quadratic variation unchanged in probability. -/
theorem tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_sq_increments_stopped_ito_add_boundedVariation
    {Omega J : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    {filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Omega)}
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {T : ℝ≥0}
    {B : ℝ≥0 → Omega → EuclideanSpace ℝ J}
    (hB : IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration B filtration mu) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hUsual : SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration mu)
    (eta : J → ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration mu T)
    (tau : Omega → ℝ≥0)
    (htau : IsChewiStoppingTime filtration (fun omega => (tau omega : WithTop ℝ≥0)))
    (htauT : ∀ omega, tau omega ≤ T)
    (A : ℝ≥0 → Omega → ℝ)
    (hAmeas : ∀ t ≤ T, AEStronglyMeasurable (A t) mu)
    (hA : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu, ContinuousOn (fun t => A t omega) (Set.Icc 0 T) ∧
      BoundedVariationOn (fun t => A t omega) (Set.Icc 0 T)) :
    let hcoord := (coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian
    let X := fun t omega => A t omega + ∑ j : J,
      itoIntegralProcess (eta j) hT (hcoord j) hUsual (min (tau omega) t) omega
    TendstoInMeasure mu
      (fun level omega =>
        let times := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T level) (2 ^ level)
        ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ level), (X (times i.succ) omega - X (times i.castSucc) omega)^2)
      atTop (fun omega => ∑ j : J, ∫ t in Set.Iic (tau omega),
        (eta j).process t omega ^ 2 ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)) := by
  intro hcoord X
  let coordinate (j : J) := itoIntegralProcess (eta j) hT (hcoord j) hUsual
  let M (t : ℝ≥0) (omega : Omega) := ∑ j : J, coordinate j (min (tau omega) t) omega
  let times (level : ℕ) := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T level) (2 ^ level)
  let Q (f : ℝ≥0 → Omega → ℝ) (level : ℕ) (omega : Omega) :=
    ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ level), (f (times level i.succ) omega - f (times level i.castSucc) omega)^2
  let E (omega : Omega) := ∑ j : J, ∫ t in Set.Iic (tau omega),
    (eta j).process t omega ^ 2 ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)
  have hCont (j : J) (omega : Omega) : Continuous (fun t => coordinate j t omega) :=
    itoIntegralProcess_continuous (eta j) hT (hcoord j) hUsual omega
  have hMC (omega : Omega) : Continuous (fun t => M t omega) :=
    continuous_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => (hCont j omega).comp (continuous_const.min continuous_id))
  have hM (t : ℝ≥0) : AEStronglyMeasurable (M t) mu := by
    have hCoordinate (j : J) : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun omega => coordinate j (min (tau omega) t) omega) mu := by
      have hs := ((itoIntegralProcess_stronglyAdapted (eta j) hT (hcoord j) hUsual).stoppedProcess
        (hCont j) htau) t
      apply (hs.mono (filtration.le t)).aestronglyMeasurable.congr
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun omega => by
        rw [stoppedProcess_coe_apply, min_comm]
    apply (Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hCoordinate j)).congr
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    simp only [M, Finset.sum_apply]
  have hTime (level : ℕ) (k : Fin (2 ^ level + 1)) : times level k ≤ T :=
    ((regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT level) _).monotone
      (Fin.le_last k)).trans_eq (regularDyadic_last_time T level)
  have hQ (f : ℝ≥0 → Omega → ℝ)
      (hf : ∀ t ≤ T, AEStronglyMeasurable (f t) mu) (level : ℕ) :
      AEStronglyMeasurable (Q f level) mu := by
    have hCell (i : Fin (2 ^ level)) : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun omega => (f (times level i.succ) omega - f (times level i.castSucc) omega)^2) mu :=
      ((hf _ (hTime level i.succ)).sub (hf _ (hTime level i.castSucc))).pow 2
    apply (Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hCell i)).congr
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    simp only [Q, Finset.sum_apply]
  have hX (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) : AEStronglyMeasurable (X t) mu :=
    (hAmeas t ht).add (hM t)
  have hLimit : (∀ level, Integrable (fun omega => Q M level omega - E omega) mu) ∧
      Tendsto (fun level => ∫ omega, |Q M level omega - E omega| ∂mu) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_dyadic_stopped_ito_row_quadraticVariation_L1 hB hT hUsual eta tau htau htauT
  have hE : AEStronglyMeasurable E mu := by
    apply ((hQ M (fun t _ => hM t) 0).sub (hLimit.1 0).aestronglyMeasurable).congr
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun omega => sub_sub_cancel _ _
  have hMeasure : TendstoInMeasure mu (Q M) atTop E := by
    apply tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_eLpNorm (p := 1) (by norm_num) (hQ M (fun t _ => hM t)) hE
    have hNorm (level : ℕ) : eLpNorm (Q M level - E) 1 mu =
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ omega, |Q M level omega - E omega| ∂mu) := by
      rw [eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm]
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.sub_apply] using
        (ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm (hLimit.1 level)).symm
    simpa only [hNorm, Function.comp_def, ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using
      ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hLimit.2
  change TendstoInMeasure mu (Q X) atTop E
  refine (exists_seq_tendstoInMeasure_atTop_iff (hQ X hX)).2 ?_
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hPath⟩ := (hMeasure.comp hn.tendsto_atTop).exists_seq_tendsto_ae
  refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hA, hPath] with omega ha hPath
  have hDrift := tendsto_dyadic_sq_increments_sub_of_continuous_boundedVariation
    (fun t => M t omega) (fun t => A t omega) T (hMC omega).continuousOn ha.1 ha.2
  have hDiff : Tendsto (fun level => Q X level omega - Q M level omega) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    refine (tendsto_congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun level => ?_)).1 hDrift
    dsimp only [Q, times, X, M, coordinate]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have hSum := (hDiff.comp (hn.tendsto_atTop.comp hk.tendsto_atTop)).add hPath
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, sub_add_cancel, zero_add] using hSum

#print axioms tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_sq_increments_stopped_ito_add_boundedVariation

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoFiniteVariationQV

steps.title: Check the stopped row as a process
steps.text: The stopped coordinate integrals are adapted and are continuous along the paths. Finite sums give the same properties for the row and give measurability of its square-increment sums.
steps.lean:
have hCont (j : J) (omega : Omega) : Continuous (fun t => coordinate j t omega) :=
    itoIntegralProcess_continuous (eta j) hT (hcoord j) hUsual omega
  have hMC (omega : Omega) : Continuous (fun t => M t omega) :=
    continuous_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => (hCont j omega).comp (continuous_const.min continuous_id))
  have hM (t : ℝ≥0) : AEStronglyMeasurable (M t) mu := by
    have hCoordinate (j : J) : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun omega => coordinate j (min (tau omega) t) omega) mu := by
      have hs := ((itoIntegralProcess_stronglyAdapted (eta j) hT (hcoord j) hUsual).stoppedProcess
        (hCont j) htau) t
      apply (hs.mono (filtration.le t)).aestronglyMeasurable.congr
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun omega => by
        rw [stoppedProcess_coe_apply, min_comm]
    apply (Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hCoordinate j)).congr
    filter_upwards [] with omega
    simp only [M, Finset.sum_apply]

steps.title: Use the stopped Itô bracket limit
steps.text: The stopped row's squared increments converge in L¹ to the literal stopped energy. Therefore they converge to that energy in measure.
steps.lean:
have hLimit : (∀ level, Integrable (fun omega => Q M level omega - E omega) mu) ∧
      Tendsto (fun level => ∫ omega, |Q M level omega - E omega| ∂mu) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_dyadic_stopped_ito_row_quadraticVariation_L1 hB hT hUsual eta tau htau htauT
  have hE : AEStronglyMeasurable E mu := by
    apply ((hQ M (fun t _ => hM t) 0).sub (hLimit.1 0).aestronglyMeasurable).congr
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun omega => sub_sub_cancel _ _
  have hMeasure : TendstoInMeasure mu (Q M) atTop E := by
    apply tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_eLpNorm (p := 1) (by norm_num) (hQ M (fun t _ => hM t)) hE
    have hNorm (level : ℕ) : eLpNorm (Q M level - E) 1 mu =
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ omega, |Q M level omega - E omega| ∂mu) := by
      rw [eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm]
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.sub_apply] using
        (ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm (hLimit.1 level)).symm
    simpa only [hNorm, Function.comp_def, ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using
      ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hLimit.2

steps.title: Pass through the drift perturbation
steps.text: The deterministic perturbation theorem holds on the full-measure event of continuous finite variation. Every subsequence of the stopped row squares has a further almost surely convergent subsequence. Add the vanishing pathwise drift difference and use the subsequence criterion.
steps.lean:
change TendstoInMeasure mu (Q X) atTop E
  refine (exists_seq_tendstoInMeasure_atTop_iff (hQ X hX)).2 ?_
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hPath⟩ := (hMeasure.comp hn.tendsto_atTop).exists_seq_tendsto_ae
  refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hA, hPath] with omega ha hPath
  have hDrift := tendsto_dyadic_sq_increments_sub_of_continuous_boundedVariation
    (fun t => M t omega) (fun t => A t omega) T (hMC omega).continuousOn ha.1 ha.2
  have hDiff : Tendsto (fun level => Q X level omega - Q M level omega) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    refine (tendsto_congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun level => ?_)).1 hDrift
    dsimp only [Q, times, X, M, coordinate]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have hSum := (hDiff.comp (hn.tendsto_atTop.comp hk.tendsto_atTop)).add hPath
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, sub_add_cancel, zero_add] using hSum
